summary: Clean, minimal simplification. --ac becomes conditional via an explicit require_acceptance_criteria keyword on check_story_contract (cmd_add passes False; import/derive keep the True default) plus a --spec-branch guard — a clearer design than an origin-based exemption, surfaced by the implementer's contradiction signal. Docs mirror stories only (both the Source-of-Truth and Task Graph Rules references fixed), and degraded-mode documents manual pr-link as a fallback. Two non-parametrized tests cover both the new and preserved behaviours.

non_blocking_findings.summary: The plan under-specified the fix (missed check_story_contract, a shared validator run before the branch); the implementer's JIT contradiction signal caught it and the fix stayed in-scope (roadmap.py). A second small doc consistency edit (task-list mirror aside) was applied in review.
